scope: Standing Piratini Palace in Porto Alegre, with the government and residential wings, open courtyard and connecting passages, main Ionic frontage, roof terraces and rounded south end.

review.notes: Started with the published Qualla files. Negrinho.jpg is an interior view with assumed authorship. Other available published media depict historic paintings unrelated to the current exterior or require attribution. The original published rendition of the 1921 and 1922 exterior views was unavailable to verify. The model uses the restoration and building survey text, original boundary, and elevation.
